card.name: Neuronal and neurological before disease terms
card.fires_on: The words neuronal, neural and neurological in drug-label warnings about brain toxicity, right before a noun like apoptosis, autoantibodies, cell death or disorder. Also weakly on 'as' in 'also known as' for brain syndromes.
